passages.heading: Properties
passages.text: Employs upwind interpolation weights, with an explicit correction based on the local cell gradient
passages.why: linearUpwind is upwind interpolation plus a correction from the cell gradient, which is why the scheme entry names a gradient.

passages.heading: Properties
passages.why: The page classes linearUpwind as second order, the reason the studio prefers it to first-order upwind.

passages.heading: Properties
passages.why: The page classes the scheme as unbounded, so it can overshoot where gradients are steep; the word 'bounded' in the studio's entry belongs to 'bounded Gauss', the steady-state form of the Gauss term, and does not change that.

passages.heading: Usage
passages.why: This is the fvSchemes entry the page gives for the momentum convection term; the studio writes 'bounded Gauss linearUpwind grad(U)', which this page does not show.
